traits.flower_symmetry.note: FNA Papaver (read 2026-10-17, 70-100 spp): two sepals, four to six petals, many stamens, no spur or unequal petal described; Wikipedia Papaveraceae (read 2026-10-17) calls the family's flowers regular. Symmetry inferred, not stated by FNA.

traits.stigmatic_disc.note: Flora of North America vol. 3, Papaver (read 2026-10-19): stigmas 3-18[-22], radiating on sessile, more or less lobed disc; capsules pored or short-valved immediately beneath persistent stigmatic disc.
